fact: A World Bank-linked consultant writes that the national validation workshop for Seychelles' National Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031, which covers responsible AI adoption, concluded in the two weeks before 10 July 2026; no adoption is stated.
Seychelles' Cabinet approved the Seychelles Digital & AI Strategy 2026-2031 on 28 October 2026 as the national framework for digital and AI transformation through 2031.

Cabinet approved establishing an Inter-Ministerial Digital and AI Coordination Committee, chaired by the Minister responsible for ICT, with focal points in Ministries to support implementation of the strategy.
